name: People Memory
description: Workspace-scoped people and group memory backed by SQLite.

dataDir.description: Data directory template. Defaults to {stateDir}/plugins/people/{workspaceKey} (state dir per workspace, like plugins/<id>). Supports {stateDir}, {workspace}, {workspaceKey}, {agentDir}, {agentId}, {home}.

workspaceDataDirs.description: Per-workspace data directory overrides, keyed by absolute workspace path.

captureSkipSenders.description: Sender ids (regex, case-insensitive) that never become people. Defaults to system/cron auto-rows like bncr-history-system.

writeTools.description: Master switch for tools that write (remember, name, note, bind, forget, merge, unbind, cycle, backup, scan mark). Default true. `capture` only controls automatic hook capture, not tool writes.

platformTemplate.description: Identity-space template. {channel} is the host-normalized channel name; BNCR appends its backend from inbound metadata. Host accountId never enters identity.

platformOverrides.description: Explicit per-channel identity-space templates, for example {"telegram":"telegram"}.

multiAccountChannels.description: Channels whose identity space requires a backend segment (e.g. bncr -> bncr/tgBot). Bare channel writes are deferred; bare rows are flagged and cleaned by health/repair.

senderFamilies.description: Platform label pairs whose sender ids share one space (GewePlus + GolemPlus are two accesses of the same WeChat platform). Same-sender rows in a family auto-bind to one person; there is no alias concept.
